mapper.select: SELECT T.PORTFOLIO_ID, T.FINPROD_ID, TF.BRANCH LIBRANCH, T.TRADE_DATE, T.SETTLE_DATE, DECODE(T.FINPROD_TYPE2, 'F01', T.SHARE_AMT * 100, P.REMAIN_PRIN_AMT) REMAIN_PRIN_AMT, P.THEORY_AMT, T.INT_AMT, P.THEORY_AMT - T.INT_AMT - NVL(TF2.INT_AMT, 0) UNPAID_INT_AMT, T.IS_CLEAN FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL P ON P.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TF ON TF.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND TF.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TF.IS_CANCEL = 'N' LEFT JOIN (SELECT TF2.FINPROD_ID, TF2.PORTFOLIO_ID, TF2.SETTLE_DATE, SUM(TF2.INT_AMT) INT_AMT FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TF2 WHERE TF2.PS = 'T02' AND TF2.IS_OVERDUE_DEAL = 'Y' AND TF2.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TF2.IS_CANCEL = 'N' GROUP BY TF2.FINPROD_ID, TF2.PORTFOLIO_ID, TF2.SETTLE_DATE) TF2 ON TF2.FINPROD_ID = T.FINPROD_ID AND TF2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TF2.SETTLE_DATE = T.SETTLE_DATE WHERE T.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND T.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND T.PS = 'T09' AND T.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL AND T.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.TRADE_DATE = #{settleDate, jdbcType=DATE}
